resources.string: 1. Paste a YouTube or Instagram link
Tip: in YouTube or Instagram, tap Share and choose FamilyTube for a quick popup. Downloads keep going in the background; watch the notification bar.
Statuses you\'ve watched in WhatsApp show here. Tap one to view it, or Save to keep it after it disappears. Saved in Download > FamilyTube > WhatsApp Status.
First time only: FamilyTube needs permission to see WhatsApp\'s status folder.\n\nTap the button below. When the folder opens, tap \"Use this folder\" at the bottom, then \"Allow\".
No statuses yet. Open WhatsApp, watch some statuses, then come back here.
Tap one to start. It downloads in the background. Check the notification bar.
